$comment: Walkthrough anchor registry. THE source of truth for which data-tour anchors exist.
Guarded in BOTH directions by ui/scripts/check-tour-anchors.mjs, which runs inside every build.
Why 'reachableWhen' exists, and why it is not optional:
document.querySelector('[data-tour=x]') returns null for two causes with OPPOSITE remedies -
the element has not mounted yet (navigate/wait), or the anchor was renamed or deleted (defect).
A tour engine that cannot tell them apart takes the reassuring reading and narrates an empty
rectangle while every gate stays green. That is finding F-4, and it was reproduced live during
the I-3 spike. This field is what makes the two distinguishable at runtime.
Add an entry and its data-tour attribute TOGETHER - the gate fails on either one alone.

anchors.describes: the version number and the live/static agent status dot, top right
the Dashboard button in the centre of the top bar
Snap - grabs the window you last used and snaps it into a region you pick
Minimize all / Restore all - the reliable 'show desktop' toggle
Clear Present Grid - empties the current monitor's grid only
Clear All Grids - wipes every monitor's grid (confirm-gated)
the per-monitor grid density picker, e.g. 6x6
Close all windows - graceful close of every window (confirm-gated)
the status readout at the right of the bottom bar
